events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Doncic (LAL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the 76ers.
Embiid (PHI) brings his hands towards Reaves (LAL) as he releases away from the contact.
Ayton (LAL) legally contests Embiid's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Reaves (LAL) establishes himself in George's (PHI) path prior to the contact.
Grimes (PHI) directly contests James' (LAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to James' hand after the release.
Edgecombe (PHI) makes contact with the ball after it has exited the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
James (LAL) and Grimes (PHI) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
James (LAL) is bracing for the contact from Grimes (PHI) and he releases away from the contact at the end of the drive.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in Reaves' (LAL) path prior to the contact.
Reaves (LAL) legally contests Embiid's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
James (LAL) avoids stepping out of bounds as he pursues the loose ball and then completes the pass to his teammate.

There is no clear and conclusive camera angle that shows if Reaves (LAL) steps out of bounds while in possession of the ball.  James' (LAL) request for a timeout is not recognized by the officiating crew.
James (LAL) contests Maxey's (PHI) jump shot and the contact after the release is marginal.
Edgecombe (PHI) commits a take foul on Doncic (LAL).
George (PHI) commits a take foul on Doncic (DAL).
